name: Forest — Far Layer
description: Distant rolling forest silhouettes layered against a soft misty sky, slow parallax. Cool desaturated greens fading into warm cream-blue mist on the horizon — storybook depth, painterly atmospheric perspective.
palette_constraints: Cool desaturated greens and blue-greys for distant trees, soft warm cream/pale-blue sky gradient. No hard outlines, no harsh saturation, no character-bright greens — far layer reads atmospheric and dreamy.

name: Forest — Mid Layer
description: Mid-ground forest band with bushy painterly trees and a winding dirt path entering from the left, medium parallax. More detail than the far layer; sky areas where it shows through must be transparent for compositing.
palette_constraints: Mid-saturation forest greens with soft painterly highlights, warm dirt browns for the path, occasional pastel pink/yellow flower accents. Sky pixels (anywhere the far layer should show through) must be FULLY TRANSPARENT (alpha=0). No flat sky-blue plate.

name: Forest — Near Layer
description: Foreground grass tufts, close fern leaves, and a single dark painterly tree trunk on the right edge, fastest parallax. Mostly transparent so the mid and far layers show through.
palette_constraints: Saturated rich greens and warm-dark tree-trunk browns. All non-foreground pixels MUST be FULLY TRANSPARENT (alpha=0) so far/mid layers composite cleanly behind.
